verdict.rationale: Keycloak is an IdP/auth server offering standard OIDC endpoints and generic client registration, but the evidence pack shows no first-party Next.js/edge middleware SDKs or framework-specific session-verification middleware; only generic OIDC well-known endpoints and admin console client setup are documented. missing for 10: first-party Next.js SDK/middleware, edge session verification support, any framework-specific integration guides.
